title: Member Pricing at Resort Outlets: Resort Club Memberships Discount Schedule
content:
Member discounts of Resort Club Memberships at resort outlets, by level and by kind of purchase. A discount of 0% means the level carries no member discount for that kind of purchase.

## Member discount by kind of purchase

| Membership level | Spa treatments | Food and beverage at resort outlets | Resort shops | Cabana day rental | Personal training |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Fitness Club Membership | 0% | 0% | 10% | 0% | 10% |
| Pool & Fitness Club Membership | 0% | 0% | 10% | 0% | 10% |
| Spa Club Membership | 20% | 10% | 15% | 0% | 10% |
| Beach & Pool Club Membership | 10% | 10% | 10% | 25% | 10% |
| Family Resort Club Membership | 10% | 15% | 15% | 25% | 15% |
| Founders Resort Club Membership | 25% | 20% | 20% | 50% | 20% |

## Cabana and personal training prices

| Membership level | Cabana day rate before the member discount (USD) | Complimentary cabana days per membership year | One-hour personal training session before the member discount (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Fitness Club Membership | 0.00 (cabanas not offered) | 0 | 95.00 |
| Pool & Fitness Club Membership | 0.00 (cabanas not offered) | 0 | 95.00 |
| Spa Club Membership | 0.00 (cabanas not offered) | 0 | 95.00 |
| Beach & Pool Club Membership | 250.00 | 2 | 95.00 |
| Family Resort Club Membership | 250.00 | 4 | 95.00 |
| Founders Resort Club Membership | 250.00 | 12 | 95.00 |

## Notes on the schedule

- A cabana day rate of 0.00 marks a level where cabanas are not offered: the Fitness Club Membership, the Pool & Fitness Club Membership and the Spa Club Membership.
- The spa treatment discount is highest at the Founders Resort Club Membership (25%) and is 20% at the Spa Club Membership, above the 10% of the Beach & Pool and Family Resort levels.
- The one-hour personal training session is priced at 95.00 at every level; the member discount on it is 10% at the first four levels, 15% at the Family Resort Club Membership and 20% at the Founders Resort Club Membership.
- Complimentary cabana days are counted per membership year: 2 at the Beach & Pool Club Membership, 4 at the Family Resort Club Membership and 12 at the Founders Resort Club Membership.
